projects.title: Testing Numerical Utility Libraries
bullets: Reproduced reported software defects in small open-source numerical utility libraries using Python during a supervised undergraduate capstone.
Documented test failures and fixes, and wrote unit tests for library utility functions using pytest.

projects.title: Reproducible Scientific Table Processing
bullets: Assembled a scripted data-cleaning workflow using Python and pandas for public scientific tables within a supervised undergraduate team course project.
Recorded software dependencies and reproduced summary tables from raw inputs for public environmental analysis workflows.

research.title: Path Search on Transportation Graphs
bullets: Implemented shortest-path queries using Python and NetworkX for public transportation graphs as a student assistant in supervised faculty research.
Compared search times on sampled graphs drawn from public multimodal transit networks as part of the assigned research tasks.

research.title: Reproducible Transport Analysis Tables
bullets: Recorded software dependencies for reproducible processing of public scientific tables as a student assistant in supervised faculty research.
Reproduced summary tables from raw public transport analysis inputs using Python and pandas.
